title: The Crossing
author: McCarthy, Cormac
review:
Probably my favorite McCarthy book. The aimlessness and anti climatic tendencies of McCarthy work really well here and give you a lot to think about as there's a lot of thematic complexity in the novel. I keep waffling between a 4 and 5 rating, his books are hard to measure compared to most normal books but I keep coming back for more, so I'm definitely a fan.

Some of it can end up being unsatisfying but that seems like the goal, still getting used to that. Really gorgeous writing and some of the digressions here from the strangers Billy meets through his travels I'll be thinking about for a while.
